story.value: Bohrium was first produced in 1976 by scientists working at the Joint Institute for Nuclear Research in Dubna, Russia.
In 1981, Peter Armbruster, Gottfried Münzenber and their team in Darmstadt, Germany, confirmed the production of bohrium.

uses.value: Only a few atoms of bohrium have ever been made, so it currently has no uses outside of basic scientific research.
